metadata.title: Acme Health Patient Intake API - Compliance Component Definition

components.title: S3 Uploads Bucket (PHI at rest + in transit)
components.description: The inherited Patient Intake API uploads bucket, hardened with customer-managed KMS encryption at rest and a TLS-only bucket policy. Holds PHI.
components.purpose: Store patient intake uploads with encryption at rest and enforced transport security.

control-implementations.description: NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls satisfied by the uploads bucket, mapped to the HIPAA Security Rule (declared primary framework).

implemented-requirements.description: SSE-KMS with the customer-managed CMK (aws_kms_key.phi) is enforced on the uploads bucket. Rego policy s3_sse_kms denies any non-aws:kms algorithm.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle (plan.json + policy-results.json), verifiable via scripts/verify-evidence.sh.

implemented-requirements.description: A bucket policy denies all non-TLS (aws:SecureTransport=false) access. Rego policy s3_tls_only denies any bucket policy lacking this statement.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle (plan.json + policy-results.json), verifiable via scripts/verify-evidence.sh.

components.title: DynamoDB Intake Table (PHI at rest)
components.description: The patient intake submissions table, encrypted at rest with the customer-managed CMK.
components.purpose: Persist patient intake submissions with customer-managed encryption.

control-implementations.description: NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls satisfied by the DynamoDB table, mapped to the HIPAA Security Rule.

implemented-requirements.description: Server-side encryption uses the customer-managed CMK (aws_kms_key.phi). Rego policy dynamodb_cmk denies AWS-owned or AWS-managed keys.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle (plan.json + policy-results.json), verifiable via scripts/verify-evidence.sh.

components.title: CloudTrail Audit Trail
components.description: Multi-region CloudTrail with log-file validation and CMK encryption, providing the account-wide audit record.
components.purpose: Produce a complete, tamper-evident audit trail of all API activity.

control-implementations.description: NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls satisfied by CloudTrail, mapped to the HIPAA Security Rule.

implemented-requirements.description: A multi-region trail with enable_log_file_validation captures all management and global service events. Rego policy cloudtrail_audit denies the absence of a multi-region, log-validated trail.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle (plan.json + policy-results.json), verifiable via scripts/verify-evidence.sh.

components.title: Lambda Execution IAM Role (least privilege)
components.description: The intake Lambda's execution role, scoped to specific DynamoDB/S3/KMS actions on specific resources.
components.purpose: Grant the intake function only the access it needs, no wildcards.

control-implementations.description: NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls satisfied by the IAM role, mapped to the HIPAA Security Rule.

implemented-requirements.description: The inline role policy grants only scoped DynamoDB/S3/KMS actions on specific resource ARNs. Rego policy iam_least_privilege denies any Action:* on Resource:* in inline policies.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle (plan.json + policy-results.json), verifiable via scripts/verify-evidence.sh.

components.title: Evidence Vault (Object Lock preservation)
components.description: S3 bucket with Object Lock in COMPLIANCE mode and 365-day retention, holding the signed evidence bundles produced by the pipeline.
components.purpose: Immutably preserve signed compliance evidence for the retention period.

control-implementations.description: NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls satisfied by the evidence vault, mapped to the HIPAA Security Rule.

implemented-requirements.description: Object Lock COMPLIANCE mode with 365-day retention protects audit evidence from deletion or modification, including by root. This is the preservation leg verified by scripts/verify-evidence.sh.

links.text: Receipt for the signed bundle in this immutable vault, including version-id and object key.
